segments.title: Shenzhen Trilateral
segments.dialogue: In Shenzhen, Chinese President Xi Jinping personally greeted U.S. President Donald Trump on the tarmac — a rare gesture. Russian President Vladimir Putin joined them for handshakes, a group photo, and a banquet on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Formal trilateral talks are the focus of today. Reported topics include Ukraine, Iran, nuclear arms control, trade, and AI. Xi and Putin earlier criticized protectionism and sanctions. This is the first time these three leaders have sat down together in this format. VERIFIED: arrivals, greetings, talks. REPORTED: outcomes still developing. Sources: Reuters, Guardian, PBS NewsHour, 18-19 Nov 2026. What does this first trilateral mean for African nations navigating multipolar diplomacy? Tap, share, send DJ a Rose if you like — optional.
segments.speaker: Nefertiti

segments.title: Liberia Maritime & UNSC Path
segments.dialogue: Today in Marshall, Margibi County, Liberia hosts a high-level Global Maritime Security Dialogue on safety, security, and seafarer welfare. Liberia prepares to assume the rotating presidency of the UN Security Council in December — the first time in 65 years. President Joseph Nyuma Boakai is expected to deliver a keynote. The dialogue addresses piracy, cyber threats, illegal fishing, and Liberia's duties as a major flag state. This builds on Liberia's Feminist Foreign Policy. VERIFIED. Sources: Liberia Maritime Authority, The New Dawn, GNN Liberia, 17-18 Nov 2026. Maritime insecurity affects African coastal economies, food chains, and seafarer safety. Where are you watching from? Drop your country in the chat.

segments.title: US Political Shift
segments.dialogue: In the United States, Democrat Mary Peltola has won the Alaska Senate race, contributing to a projected 56-seat Democratic Party majority in the new Senate. House Democrats have formally nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker, positioning him to become the first Black lawmaker to hold that role. These follow the recent midterm elections and will shape the incoming Congress. VERIFIED: election outcomes and nomination. Sources: AP, NPR, 18 Nov 2026.
